questions.stem: A newborn exhibits persistent unconjugated hyperbilirubinemia that does not resolve within the first three weeks of life. Laboratory investigations reveal normal liver function tests, normal prothrombin time/international normalized ratio (PT/INR), and normal serum albumin levels. No evidence of hemolysis is found on a blood smear. After initiating phenobarbital therapy, the bilirubin levels decrease significantly within a week. Which of the following is the most probable diagnosis?
